description: This file defines a mock class for the INetworkManager interface used in unit testing, utilizing Google Mock framework to mock methods for network management functionalities.

classes.name: MockINetworkManager
classes.description: A mock implementation of the INetworkManager interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the primary network interface name.

methods.name: GetIPSettings
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of IP settings for a specified interface and IP version.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks registration of a network manager notification.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks unregistration of a network manager notification.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Mocks querying for a specific interface.
